question: Should existing Comfy `workflowPath` configurations larger than 16 MiB become unsupported with a local error, or should the supported maximum be set differently?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but the exact fixed cap is a new compatibility contract for existing plugin configurations and cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Accept the 16 MiB contract
options.body: Confirm that 16 MiB is the supported maximum for Comfy workflow files and merge the bounded reader with its current error behavior.

options.title: Choose a different supported boundary
options.body: Set a documented maximum that better matches supported Comfy workflow sizes, then retain the same bounded-read implementation and regression coverage.

options.title: Avoid a fixed compatibility break
options.body: Pause this PR if a hard maximum is not an acceptable product contract and pursue an owner-approved alternative.

recommendation.title: Accept the 16 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that 16 MiB is the supported maximum for Comfy workflow files and merge the bounded reader with its current error behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This requires a bundled-plugin compatibility decision rather than a mechanical correction to the contributor branch.
